esplink_wifi_begin.tooltip: Connect to a WiFi network through the ESP32-C3; does not wait for the result

esplink_wifi_begin_advanced.tooltip: Connect on a fixed channel; 0 means automatic

esplink_wifi_connect_quick.message0: quick connect WiFi name %1 password %2 timeout %3 ms
esplink_wifi_connect_quick.tooltip: Connect and wait for the result; returns true when connected

esplink_wifi_wait_connected.message0: wait for WiFi result timeout %1 ms
esplink_wifi_wait_connected.tooltip: Block until the connection result is known and return the WiFi status value

esplink_wifi_status_type.tooltip: WiFi status constant, for comparison with the current status

esplink_wifi_disconnect.message0: disconnect WiFi radio off %1 erase saved password %2
esplink_wifi_disconnect.tooltip: Disconnect from the current WiFi network

esplink_wifi_set_auto_reconnect.tooltip: Let the C3 reconnect automatically after a disconnect

esplink_wifi_set_mode.tooltip: Set the radio mode of the C3

esplink_wifi_poll.tooltip: Advance the link and dispatch WiFi events; WiFi blocks add this automatically

esplink_wifi_end.tooltip: Release WiFi resources without affecting BLE

esplink_wifi_ip_info.tooltip: Return a network address as text

esplink_wifi_rssi.tooltip: Signal strength in dBm; closer to 0 is better

esplink_wifi_mac.tooltip: MAC address of the station interface

esplink_wifi_set_hostname.tooltip: Name shown on the router; set it before connecting

esplink_wifi_config_static.message0: set static IP %1 gateway %2 subnet mask %3 DNS %4
esplink_wifi_config_static.tooltip: Use a static IPv4 configuration; call it before connecting

esplink_wifi_host_by_name.tooltip: Resolve a host name on the C3; empty string on failure

esplink_wifi_firmware_version.tooltip: Firmware version running on the C3

esplink_wifi_last_error.tooltip: Error code of the last WiFi operation; 0 means success

esplink_wifi_config_time.message0: configure network time zone %1 hours DST %2 hours server %3
esplink_wifi_config_time.tooltip: Configure SNTP on the C3; TLS certificate checks need a valid clock

esplink_wifi_get_time.tooltip: Unix timestamp from the C3; small values mean it is not synchronised yet

esplink_wifi_scan_networks.tooltip: Scan synchronously and return the number of networks found; up to 32 are cached

esplink_wifi_scan_start_async.message0: start async WiFi scan include hidden %1
esplink_wifi_scan_start_async.tooltip: Scan in the background; poll the result count for progress

esplink_wifi_scan_complete.tooltip: Number of networks found; -1 means running, -2 means failed

esplink_wifi_scan_ssid.tooltip: SSID of the scan result at this index; indexes start at 0

esplink_wifi_scan_rssi.tooltip: Signal strength of the scan result at this index, in dBm

esplink_wifi_scan_channel.tooltip: Channel of the scan result at this index

esplink_wifi_scan_encryption.tooltip: Encryption type value of the scan result; 0 is an open network

esplink_wifi_scan_delete.tooltip: Free the memory used by scan results

esplink_wifi_softap.message0: create WiFi hotspot name %1 password %2 channel %3
esplink_wifi_softap.tooltip: Create a hotspot on the C3; an empty password means an open network

esplink_wifi_softap_config.message0: set hotspot network IP %1 gateway %2 subnet mask %3
esplink_wifi_softap_config.tooltip: Set the hotspot IPv4 range; call it before creating the hotspot

esplink_wifi_softap_ip.tooltip: IP address of the hotspot itself

esplink_wifi_softap_station_num.tooltip: Number of devices connected to the hotspot

esplink_wifi_softap_mac.tooltip: MAC address of the hotspot interface

esplink_wifi_on_event.tooltip: Register a WiFi event handler; events come from polled state differences and run in the task that services WiFi

esplink_tcp_client_connect.tooltip: Connect to a server; true on success. Default timeout is 10s (15s for TLS)

esplink_tcp_client_connected.tooltip: Whether the connection is usable; also true while buffered data remains

esplink_tcp_client_available.tooltip: Number of bytes ready to read

esplink_tcp_client_read_string.tooltip: Take everything currently buffered without waiting

esplink_tcp_client_remote_ip.tooltip: IP address of the connection peer

esplink_tcp_client_stop.tooltip: Close the connection and release the socket on the C3

esplink_tls_client_create.tooltip: Create an HTTPS/TLS capable client; uses the C3 built-in root certificates by default

esplink_tls_set_pem.tooltip: Set a PEM certificate or key; each credential is limited to 8192 bytes

esplink_tls_use_builtin_ca.message0: TLS client %1 use built-in root certificates
esplink_tls_use_builtin_ca.tooltip: Validate the server with the certificate store built into the C3 firmware

esplink_tls_set_insecure.tooltip: Do not validate the server certificate; use only when that is intended

esplink_http_get.tooltip: Request an http:// or https:// URL and return the body; empty on failure, at most 4096 bytes

esplink_http_post.tooltip: Post a body to an http:// or https:// URL and return the response body; empty on failure

esplink_tcp_server_create.message0: create TCP server %1 listening on port %2
esplink_tcp_server_create.tooltip: Create a TCP server and start listening on every local address

esplink_tcp_server_accept.tooltip: Hand the next incoming connection to the chosen variable; it stays invalid when there is none

esplink_tcp_server_write.tooltip: Broadcast to the clients the server retained

esplink_tcp_server_end.tooltip: Stop listening and release the port

esplink_udp_create.tooltip: Create a UDP object and bind a local port; 0 picks an ephemeral port

esplink_udp_create_multicast.tooltip: Create a UDP object bound to a multicast address

esplink_udp_send_to.tooltip: Build and send one datagram in a single step; true on success. Limit is 1472 bytes

esplink_udp_begin_packet.tooltip: Start a datagram to be sent

esplink_udp_write.tooltip: Append content to the pending datagram

esplink_udp_end_packet.tooltip: Send the pending datagram; more than 1472 bytes fails as a whole

esplink_udp_parse_packet.tooltip: Take the next datagram and return its size; 0 when none. Discards the unread remainder of the previous one

esplink_udp_read_string.tooltip: Read everything left in the current datagram

esplink_udp_remote_ip.tooltip: IP address of the sender of the current datagram

esplink_udp_stop.tooltip: Close UDP and release the socket on the C3

esplink_begin.tooltip: Start the link on the board's default hardware UART at 921600 baud. The WiFi and BLE libraries start ESPLink automatically; use this block for standalone diagnostics

esplink_begin_serial.tooltip: Start ESPLink on an explicit UART and baud. It must match the C3 firmware baud and run before WiFi/BLE setup

esplink_bind_stream.tooltip: Borrow a serial port the sketch already configured (custom pins). ESPLink never calls its begin() or end()

esplink_end.tooltip: Release the ESPLink binding. In borrowed mode the serial driver stays open

esplink_poll.tooltip: Advance the ESPLink transport. Startup blocks add this to the main loop automatically

esplink_ready.tooltip: Whether the C3 link holds a usable session

esplink_ping.tooltip: Send one ping to the C3 and wait for the reply

esplink_session.tooltip: Current link session id. A change means the C3 restarted or the link was rebuilt, and all earlier sockets and BLE handles are invalid

esplink_last_error.tooltip: Error code of the last ESPLink operation; 0 means success

esplink_error_code.tooltip: ESPLink error constant, for comparison with the last error code

esplink_firmware_version.tooltip: Version string of the bridge firmware running on the ESP32-C3

esplink_capability.tooltip: Read a capability value reported during the C3 handshake

esplink_has_feature.tooltip: Whether the C3 firmware supports the selected feature

esplink_stat.tooltip: Read link quality counters to troubleshoot wiring and baud problems
